result.label: Generated password
result.copiedClears: Password copied. It will be cleared from the clipboard in {seconds} s.
result.onDevice: Created on this device with cryptographic randomness. It is not sent anywhere.

strength.instant: An attack making 10 billion guesses per second would find it instantly.
strength.minutes: An attack making 10 billion guesses per second would find it in minutes or hours.
strength.days: An attack making 10 billion guesses per second would need days or months to find it.
strength.years: An attack making 10 billion guesses per second would need years to find it.
strength.centuries: An attack making 10 billion guesses per second would need centuries to find it.
strength.pin: A PIN only protects where attempts are limited, such as a card or a phone.

random.lastClass: At least one character type has to stay on.
random.excludeAmbiguousHint: No 0, O, o, 1, l, I, the bar | or quotes: they are easy to mix up when read or dictated.
random.customSymbolsHint: Leave it empty to use the usual ones. Symbols only: letters, numbers and spaces are dropped.
random.customSymbolsUnusable: A password cannot be generated with these symbols. The usual ones are used meanwhile.

passphrase.separatorHint: Up to 8 characters. Empty joins the words with nothing between them.
passphrase.capitalizeHint: Every word starts with a capital letter.
passphrase.includeNumberHint: Adds a digit to the end of one of the words.

ai.title: Tell me what you need
ai.description: The assistant chooses the settings for you. It only receives your description: the password is always generated on this device.
ai.label: What you need
ai.placeholder: A password for the bank, 16 characters at most and no symbols
ai.hint: Do not type any password here.
ai.required: Describe what you need, in your own words.
ai.offline: Understanding your description needs a connection. The rest of the generator works without one.
ai.sourceAiHint: Settings suggested by the AI from your description.
ai.sourceRulesHint: Settings chosen by the built-in rules of AccioPass, without AI.

history.title: History of this session
history.description: Passwords you copy, save or replace stay here until the vault locks. They are not written to disk.
history.empty: Nothing yet. Copy a password or generate another one and it will show up here.
history.clearMessage: Passwords you have not saved to the vault cannot be brought back.
